decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with through contacts are a technologically promising option in MEMS and advanced packaging whose market value is still uncertain one year after launch, and keeping it in a wafer-processing portfolio costs little, so the option should stay open.
Carrier wafers for handling smaller diameters build on Plan Optik's existing glass-wafer capabilities at low incremental cost, and one year of evidence is too little to justify abandoning the option.
